notes: Hand-written outline for scripts/generate_seed.py. Times are a nominal local clock (timezone);
the story is written for a demo on Sunday 2026-10-25 around noon: Priya joined Friday at noon, the
playoff game is Saturday evening, the drama is Saturday night, and the hangout it argues about is
Sunday 8pm, still ahead at demo time. The fixture stores offsets before nominal_now plus an anchor;
the loader moves the anchor by whole weeks so weekdays and clock times in the text stay true.
Sections are generated in batches; 'after' chains a section to the tail of an earlier one. A beat's
'done' text is what later batches of the same section are told already happened. Scripts are
inserted verbatim where the LLM places a {"script": key} marker, so term origins are exact.
The generated transcripts in scripts/transcripts/ are committed and hand-fixed; see generate_seed.py.
style: texting like real college students: mostly lowercase, slang (fr, ngl, lowkey, bet, ong, deadass, 💀, 😭), typos, abbreviations (u, rn, tmrw, idk, wya)
short bursts: the same person often sends 2-4 short messages in a row; long messages are rare
uneven participation: a few people talk a lot, some lurk and drop one-liners; never round-robin through the cast
people talk over each other, threads interleave, some questions get ignored
occasional links: imleagues.com schedule links, tiktok.com or instagram.com/reel links, google maps links
mild swearing is fine; nothing explicit or mean-spirited
never use real full names of people not in the chat, never mention being an AI or a script
